spots.text: SWIMMERS ONLY. The lake is not responsible for anything it contains.
HIGH WATER. It has never been higher. It has never been lower, either.

secrets.name: The Air Pocket
secrets.text: You come up out of the lake into a pocket of air under its bed, a stone ledge and a lamp and a chair. Someone swam up here with a book and a towel, and meant to stay.

meta.label: The Lake Overhead
meta.blurb: The ceiling is a lake. It hangs there, green and perfectly still, and fish go over. A rope ladder goes up into it, for anyone who wants to.
